video_title: Where Does LeBron Go? A Season of Clues

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on LeBron James's potential move to Cleveland
quotes.excerpt: 52-year-old LeBron ain't going to solve them issues. They got soul issues.
quotes.quote: I don't like the setup. Cleveland got too many what-ifs now. After seeing what I saw, 52-year-old LeBron ain't going to solve them issues. They got soul issues. They got like, I don't like you issues and I don't want to be here with you issues. If this team was like, hey, we just need this position, I'd be like, boom, go to Cleveland. They have a that doesn't work with this, and this doesn't work with that. And how are we, when your youngest, best player starting to get all these rumors, that mean people are on the phone. That mean people, they think he could get got. And I'm not going to Evan Mobley. Evan Mobley stuck there.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the challenges of a LeBron James-led team
quotes.excerpt: You think James Harden only operates when he has the ball in his hand most of the time.
quotes.quote: You think James Harden only operates when he has the ball in his hand most of the time. I'm not giving the ball to James Harden if LeBron's on the team. Yeah, I'm not doing the scenarios. I don't know where he's going. I wish him the best. Honestly, I don't care.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the historical gap in Lakers leadership
quotes.excerpt: There was a gap between Magic and Shaq and Kobe. There was a gap between Shaq and Kobe and Kobe and Pau.
quotes.quote: There was a gap between Magic and Shaq and Kobe. There was a gap between Shaq and Kobe and Kobe and Pau. There was a gap between Kobe and Pau and LeBron and AD. When LeBron leaves, there's going to be a gap. It was 2020. We are 2026 now. There's going to be another championship gap.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on LeBron James's enduring impact
quotes.excerpt: What he does is so impressive even at his age. Let's stop talking about his age.
quotes.quote: You can take LeBron and the 50 million, what he does is so impressive even at his age. Let's stop talking about his age. If we just talk about what he's doing and just looking at it in a vacuum and saying this season, what he's brought to the table, it's like, come on y'all. I'm okay if you want to hate, but don't minimize it.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on Donovan Mitchell and James Harden recruiting LeBron
quotes.excerpt: Donovan Mitchell and James Harden already are starting the push to go and recruit LeBron James.
quotes.quote: My sources told me that Donovan Mitchell and James Harden already are starting the push to go and recruit LeBron James this off-season. Soon as James Harden got on the phone or got around the team, the initial was, hey, we about to make this run, we about to go all out, but we want LeBron James.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on LeBron James's current status with the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: I feel like LeBron has one foot in the grave and the other on the banana peel.
quotes.quote: I feel like LeBron has one foot in the grave and the other on the banana peel right now when it comes to the Lakers. He's just getting through the season. He's still going to compete at a high level, but he's just getting through the season.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on LeBron James's versatility and team fit
quotes.excerpt: LeBron has the ability even at this age to lend himself in different directions for the basis.
quotes.quote: LeBron has the ability even at this age to lend himself in different directions for the basis of a team. I do not think that AR and Luka should move anywhere for LeBron. I think LeBron is smart enough and talented enough to say, you know what, here's where you guys need me and I can be the best version of that. I just think that's where we're at right now.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on LeBron James's trust in teammates
quotes.excerpt: Two people that I know that LeBron James trusts on that roster is Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves.
quotes.quote: Two people that I know that LeBron James trusts on that roster is Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves. Here's why I say Austin Reaves. I'm not going to look at last year post-season because Luka was out of shape. They didn't have a big man. They played LeBron at the five. He was exhausted. A lot of things didn't go their way. But when they made a Western Conference Finals run with Darvin Ham and Austin Reaves got the nickname I am him, he got that nickname in a game five, I believe it was or six on the road in Memphis in the fourth quarter when LeBron was on the floor, he said, here you go, take over AR.
